recipe.visualDefinition: A central silhouette of two musicians in western attire clashing guitars, set against a radial sunburst background with a faded city skyline and a textured, aged paper overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figures anchored by a large horizontal typographic banner
Radial light rays emanating from the center point behind the figures
Faded city silhouette providing a mid-ground horizon line
Heavy drop shadows on text creating depth against the flat silhouettes
coreInvariants: Muted olive and teal color palette
Symmetrical composition with central focal point
High-contrast silhouettes with internal photographic texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures scaled to occupy the middle third of the vertical space, mirrored across the central axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large, stylized script text positioned horizontally across the center of the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central light burst, follow the guitar necks upward, then drop to the main title and follow the radial shadows downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper corners are relatively open with soft radial gradients; lower corners are darker and more dense.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted olive green and teal blue gradient background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal for silhouettes and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for the central light burst and primary text fill.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high-value center fading to low-value edges.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, connected script for display; bold sans-serif for metadata.
letterConstructionRules: Display text features thick, pillowy strokes with rounded terminals
Heavy dark blue outer glow or drop shadow for legibility
Metadata text is all-caps, widely tracked, and follows a slight arc
characterSpecificRedesigns: Custom ampersand with vertical parallel lines through the center
Exaggerated swashes on the 'B' and 'R' to frame the wordmark

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the bottom of the central cluster

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, organic script paired with rigid, geometric sans-serif for structural contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the informal, energetic feel of the main title.
Provides the necessary weight for the arched subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured background with a radial sunburst in muted olive and teal. Include a faded city skyline silhouette in the mid-ground. Place two mirrored silhouettes of men in cowboy hats holding guitars in the center, with long shadows stretching toward the bottom corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold script title in the center with a cream gradient fill and a heavy dark drop shadow. Below it, add a line of all-caps sans-serif text in a slight upward arc with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the sunburst centered behind the figures?
Does the script text have a significant drop shadow?
Is the color palette desaturated and earthy?
Is the paper texture visible across all elements?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is not obscured by the background texture
Check that the radial rays don't overpower the central figures
Verify the arched text follows a consistent curve
Confirm the shadows align with the central light source
recipe.reuseFormula: Central mirrored silhouettes + radial sunburst background + heavy script overlay + arched sans-serif subtitle + distressed paper texture.
